raw_text: India on Monday rejected China's renewed claims over Arunachal Pradesh, calling them baseless and a violation of established bilateral understandings. External Affairs Ministry spokesperson stated that Arunachal Pradesh is an integral and inalienable part of India. The Indian Army's Northern Command confirmed no unusual PLA activity has been detected along the LAC.
clean_text: India rejects China's claims over Arunachal Pradesh as baseless. External Affairs Ministry reaffirms territorial integrity. Indian Army Northern Command reports no unusual PLA activity at LAC.
